assembly: Actual separately painted actions; nearest-body atlas selection preserving original RGBA, one explicit uniform camera per source viewport, fixed row/contact registration. No body deformation, shadow paint, generated-pose stand-ins or duplicated idle fillers. DEAD deliberately matches final DEATH pose.

credits.author: OpenAI built-in image_gen; project-directed genuine paintings and technical extraction
